## [RT-QuIC Kinetic Modeling](https://modeling.gagerowden.com)
A kinetic modeling tool for RT-QuIC data developed in R. Frames RT-QuIC data around classical enzyme kinetics.

## [quicR](https://github.com/gage1145/quicR)
An R package for RT-QuIC analysis.

## [PriLIMS](https://priogen.xyz/)
A laboratory information management system developed for [Priogen Corp](https://www.priogen.bio/). Utilizes a Django framework and is hosted on AWS.

## [Cookbook](https://cookbook.gagerowden.com)
My family's multigenerational recipes.
